description: Mechanistic schematic of Flea-Borne Spotted Fever (R. felis) pathophysiology synthesizing Iterations 1-3 findings
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13, 9))
ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,10); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title("Flea-Borne Spotted Fever (Rickettsia felis): Integrated Pathophysiology",
             fontsize=15, fontweight='bold')

def box(x,y,w,h,text,color):
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((x,y),w,h,boxstyle="round,pad=0.05",
                 linewidth=1.3,edgecolor='black',facecolor=color,alpha=0.9))
    ax.text(x+w/2,y+h/2,text,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=9,wrap=True)

def arrow(x1,y1,x2,y2):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((x1,y1),(x2,y2),arrowstyle='-|>',
                 mutation_scale=18,linewidth=1.8,color='dimgray'))

# Stage 1: transmission/inoculation
box(0.3,8.3,3.0,1.2,"1. TRANSMISSION\nCat flea Ctenocephalides felis\n(mosquitoes potential)\n→ dermal inoculation",'#cfe8f3')
# Stage 2: entry
box(3.7,8.3,3.0,1.2,"2. ENDOTHELIAL ENTRY\nOmpB–Annexin A2 adhesion\nFGFR1 / heparan sulfate\ninternalization",'#d5e8d4')
# Stage 3: intracellular
box(7.1,8.3,2.7,1.2,"3. INTRACELLULAR\nphagosomal escape\n(patatin phospholipase)\nRickA actin motility, mTOR",'#d5e8d4')
# Stage 4 survival
box(7.1,6.3,2.7,1.4,"4. SURVIVAL\nNF-κB blocks apoptosis\n(masks caspase-8/9/3)\n→ replication & cell-to-cell spread\nAdr1/2 complement evasion",'#ffe6cc')
# Stage 5 dissemination
box(3.7,6.3,3.0,1.4,"5. DISSEMINATION\nhematogenous spread to\nmicrovascular endothelium\n(skin, brain, lung, liver)",'#cfe8f3')
# Stage 6 vascular injury
box(0.3,6.3,3.0,1.4,"6. VASCULAR INJURY\n↑permeability, edema\nROS/oxidative injury\nprocoagulant: TXA2, thrombin\nvasculitis, microthrombi",'#f8cecc')
# Stage 7 inflammation
box(0.3,4.0,4.4,1.6,"7. INFLAMMATION (effector phase)\nEndothelium+macrophage cytokines:\nIL-8, IP-10/CXCL10, MCP-1, MIP-1α, VEGF, IL-1β, IL-6\nRecruit leukocytes → amplify permeability",'#fff2cc')
# Stage 8 protective immunity
box(5.1,4.0,4.6,1.6,"8. PROTECTIVE IMMUNITY\nNK + CD8 T cells; IFN-γ clears bacteria;\nperforin prevents thrombosis\nDeficit → severe/thrombotic disease",'#e1d5e7')
# Stage 9 clinical
box(0.3,1.8,4.4,1.6,"9. CLINICAL PHENOTYPE\nFever, headache, maculopapular rash,\n±eschar; transaminitis, thrombocytopenia\nComplications: CNS meningoencephalitis,\npleural effusion, multi-organ failure",'#f8cecc')
# Stage 10 treatment
box(5.1,1.8,4.6,1.6,"10. TREATMENT\nDoxycycline (1st-line, urgent)\nAlt: azithromycin, rifampicin,\nfluoroquinolones\nDx: IFA seroconversion, qPCR skin/eschar",'#d5e8d4')

# arrows
arrow(3.3,8.9,3.7,8.9)
arrow(6.7,8.9,7.1,8.9)
arrow(8.45,8.3,8.45,7.7)
arrow(7.1,7.0,6.7,7.0)
arrow(3.7,7.0,3.3,7.0)
arrow(1.8,6.3,1.8,5.6)   # vascular -> inflammation
arrow(4.7,4.8,5.1,4.8)   # inflammation <-> immunity
arrow(2.5,4.0,2.5,3.4)   # inflammation -> clinical
arrow(4.7,2.6,5.1,2.6)   # clinical -> treatment

ax.text(5,0.5,"Core mechanism: endothelial-targeted infection → vasculitis via oxidative + procoagulant injury and chemokine-driven permeability",
        ha='center',fontsize=10,style='italic')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('fbsf_pathophysiology_schematic.png',dpi=140,bbox_inches='tight')
print("Schematic saved. Findings integrated across 10 stages.")
